{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|arg= global

|eff= global

|gr1= Vehicle Inventory

|descr= Adds magazines with specified ammo count to the cargo space of a vehicle or a container.

|s1= cargospace [[addMagazineAmmoCargo]] [magazine, quantity, ammocount]

|p1= cargospace: [[Object]] - vehicle or container or weaponholder

|p2= magazine: [[String]] - magazine class name

|p3= quantity: [[Number]] - number of magazines to add. {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} a negative value remove magazines

|p4= ammocount: [[Number]] - ammo count in each magazine

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_ammobox addMagazineAmmoCargo ["30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag", 2, 5];</sqf>

|seealso= [[magazinesAmmoCargo]] [[addMagazineCargo]] [[addMagazineGlobal]] [[addMagazine]] [[addMagazines]] [[addMagazinePool]] [[addMagazineTurret]] [[clearMagazineCargo]] [[addWeaponCargo]] [[clearWeaponCargo]] [[clearWeaponCargo]] [[addWeaponCargoGlobal]] [[addBackpackCargoGlobal]] [[addItemCargo]] [[addItemCargoGlobal]]
